statements.text: Individualism and altruism are empirically separable dimensions in European survey data.
Institutional trust and individualism are the same underlying disposition.
A single country-level individualism score is adequate for cross-national comparison.
Reverse-worded items behave equivalently to forward-worded ones in value scales.
Scalar invariance is achievable across thirty or more European countries.
Binary 'mentioned / not mentioned' items are adequate indicators of a latent value.
Preference for a strong leader indicates high individualism.
Education-sphere indicators are comparable across European countries.
